if __name__ == '__main__':

", 'tally/core.py': 'def count(s):

', 'tests/test_core.py': "from tally.core import count

", '.github/workflows/ci.yml': 'on: push
jobs:

    steps:

'})
    order = ['README.md', 'CLAUDE.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'pyproject.toml', 'package.json', 'go.mod']

def card(work):
    p, k = (0.7, 3)
    pass_at_k = 1 - (1 - p) ** k
    pass_hat_k = p ** k
    rng = random.Random(7)
    trials = [[rng.random() < p for _ in range(k)] for _ in range(20000)]
    emp_at = sum((any(t) for t in trials)) / len(trials)
    emp_hat = sum((all(t) for t in trials)) / len(trials)
    repo = work / 'repo'
    _git_init(repo)
    (repo / 'f.txt').write_text('v1')
    _git(repo, 'add', 'f.txt')
    _git(repo, 'commit', '-qm', 'base')
    sha = _git(repo, 'rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD').strip()
    status = _git(repo, 'status', '--porcelain')
    log = work / 'checkpoints.log'
    log.write_text(f'2026-11-03 | baseline | {sha}\n')
    baseline, after = ((9, 10), (10, 10))
    _w(work, 'evals.json', {'pass@3': pass_at_k, 'pass^3': pass_hat_k, 'empirical': [emp_at, emp_hat], 'card_says': '70% -> 91% (pass@3) / 34% (pass^3)', 'note': "exact 1-(0.3)^3 = 97.3%; the card's 91% does not follow from p=0.7, k=3"})
    return [('pass^3 at p=0.7 is 34%', round(pass_hat_k * 100) == 34, f'{pass_hat_k:.3f}'), ("pass@3 at p=0.7 is 1-0.3^3 = 97.3% (formula, card's 91% flagged)", abs(pass_at_k - 0.973) < 1e-09, f'{pass_at_k:.3f}'), ('simulation agrees within 1%', abs(emp_at - pass_at_k) < 0.01 and abs(emp_hat - pass_hat_k) < 0.01, f'{emp_at:.3f}/{emp_hat:.3f}'), ('checkpoint taken on a clean tree with date|name|sha', status == '' and re.fullmatch('\\S+ \\| baseline \\| [0-9a-f]{7,}\\n', log.read_text()) is not None, log.read_text().strip()), ('regression compare: 9/10 -> 10/10 is no regression', after[0] >= baseline[0], f'{baseline} -> {after}')]

program.def:
def card(work):
    adr_dir = work / 'docs' / 'adr'
    adr_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    fields = ['Context', 'Decision drivers', 'Options considered', 'Trade-offs', 'Failure modes', 'Decision', 'Consequences', 'Kill/review criteria']
    (adr_dir / '0001-use-sqlite.md').write_text('# 1. Use SQLite\nStatus: Accepted\n')
    (adr_dir / '0002-json-logs.md').write_text('# 2. JSON logs\nStatus: Accepted\n')

    def new_adr(title, body, supersedes=None):
        nums = [int(p.name[:4]) for p in adr_dir.glob('[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-*.md')]
        n = max(nums, default=0) + 1
        slug = re.sub('[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title.lower()).strip('-')
        missing = [f for f in fields if f not in body]
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f'missing fields {missing}')
        text = f'# {n}. {title}\nStatus: Proposed\n' + (f'Supersedes: {supersedes}\n' if supersedes else '') + ''.join((f'## {f}\n{body[f]}\n' for f in fields))
        p = adr_dir / f'{n:04d}-{slug}.md'
        p.write_text(text)
        return p

    def edit(path, new_text):
        if 'Status: Accepted' in path.read_text():
            raise PermissionError('accepted ADRs are never edited; supersede instead')
        path.write_text(new_text)
    body = {f: f'{f} text' for f in fields}
    p = new_adr('Move to Postgres', body, supersedes='0001')
    try:
        edit(adr_dir / '0001-use-sqlite.md', 'changed')
        edited = True
    except PermissionError:
        edited = False
    try:
        new_adr('Incomplete', {'Context': 'x'})
        incomplete = 'accepted'
    except ValueError:
        incomplete = 'rejected'
    return [('next number is 0003 with a slug', p.name == '0003-move-to-postgres.md', p.name), ('all 8 fields present', all((f'## {f}' in p.read_text() for f in fields)), '8/8'), ('accepted ADR edit refused; superseded instead', not edited and 'Supersedes: 0001' in p.read_text(), 'refused'), ('ADR missing fields rejected', incomplete == 'rejected', incomplete)]

program.def:
def card(work):
    rng = random.Random(3)
    lines = [f'INV-{1000 + i}: {rng.randint(1, 99)}.{rng.randint(0, 99):02d} EUR' for i in range(97)]
    lines += ['invoice one-thousand: twelve euros', 'INV-77 12,5 EUR', 'see attached']
    pat = re.compile('^INV-(\\d{4}): (\\d+\\.\\d{2}) EUR$')
    direct, tail, total = ([], [], 0)
    for ln in lines:
        m = pat.match(ln)
        conf = 1.0 if m else 0.2
        if conf >= 0.95:
            direct.append(m.group(1))
            total += round(float(m.group(2)) * 100)
        else:
            tail.append(ln)
    _w(work, 'routing.json', {'direct': len(direct), 'to_model_queue': tail, 'total_cents_frozen': total, 'note': 'tail items queued for a model; no model called here'})
    expected_total = sum((round(float(l.split()[1]) * 100) for l in lines[:97]))
    return [('97/100 handled deterministically (coverage 97%)', len(direct) == 97, str(len(direct))), ('exactly the 3 malformed items go to the tail', tail == lines[97:], str(tail)), ('sum computed by code in integer cents', total == expected_total, str(total)), ('confidence cut is 0.95', pat.match(lines[0]) is not None, 'cut=0.95')]

def card(work):

    _git_init(repo)
    for i, msg in enumerate(['feat(cli): add flag', 'fix: handle empty input', 'docs: readme', 'chore: bump']):
        (repo / f'f{i}.txt').write_text(str(i))
        _git(repo, 'add', '.')
        _git(repo, 'commit', '-qm', msg)
    log = _git(repo, 'log', '--oneline', '-15').splitlines()
    conv = sum((bool(re.match('[0-9a-f]+ (feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|test)(\\(.+\\))?: ', l)) for l in log))
    style = 'conventional' if conv / len(log) >= 0.75 else 'free'
    (repo / 'app.py').write_text("TOKEN = 'ghp_" + 'a' * 36 + "'\nprint('debug here')\n")
    _git(repo, 'add', 'app.py')
    staged = _git(repo, 'diff', '--staged')
    problems = [l for l in staged.splitlines() if l.startswith('+') and (SECRET_RE.search(l) or DEBUG_RE.search(l))]
    branch = _git(repo, 'branch', '--show-current').strip()
    must_branch_first = branch in ('main', 'master')
    status_words = {'inspected': True, 'changed locally': True, 'verified locally': False, 'committed': False, 'pushed': False, 'blocked': 'secret in staged diff'}
    _w(work, 'hygiene.json', {'style': style, 'problems': problems, 'branch': branch, 'status': status_words})
    return [('Conventional Commits style detected from 4/4 messages', style == 'conventional', f'{conv}/{len(log)}'), ('staged ghp_ token flagged', any(('ghp_' in p for p in problems)), str(len(problems))), ('staged debug print flagged', any(('debug' in p for p in problems)), 'flagged'), ('on default branch -> branch first', must_branch_first, branch), ('status words report blocked, not committed', status_words['committed'] is False and status_words['blocked'], 'blocked')]

def card(work):
    f = work / 'target.py'
    f.write_text('def a():\n    return 1\n\ndef b():\n    return 1\n\ndef c():\n    return 2\n')

    def apply(block):
        text = f.read_text()
        n = text.count(block['search'])
        if n == 1:
            f.write_text(text.replace(block['search'], block['replace']))
            return ('applied', [])
        lines = text.splitlines()
        near = difflib.get_close_matches(block['search'].splitlines()[0], lines, n=2, cutoff=0.3)
        return ('ambiguous' if n > 1 else 'no-match', near)
    r1 = apply({'search': '    return 1\n', 'replace': '    return 9\n'})
    r2 = apply({'search': 'def c():\n    return 2\n', 'replace': 'def c():\n    return 3\n'})
    r3 = apply({'search': 'def cc():\n    return 2\n', 'replace': 'x'})
    _w(work, 'edits.json', {'r1': r1, 'r2': r2, 'r3': r3, 'final': f.read_text()})
    return [('2 matches -> rejected as ambiguous, file untouched', r1[0] == 'ambiguous' and 'return 9' not in f.read_text(), r1[0]), ('unique block applied', r2[0] == 'applied' and 'return 3' in f.read_text(), r2[0]), ('no match -> nearest lines shown, not guessed', r3[0] == 'no-match' and 'def c():' in r3[1], str(r3[1])), ('rest of file preserved byte for byte', f.read_text().count('return 1') == 2, 'preserved')]
